SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TERM_GROUP_ID AS TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID AS TERM_ID, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_CNT, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS FAULT_RATE, MAX(CASE WHEN THEN JNL_DATE END) AS LAST_FAULT_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN THEN JNL_TIME END) AS LAST_FAULT_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN THEN ERR_CD END) AS LAST_ERR_CD FROM T_ATM_MONITOR
GROUP BY TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= #{minFaultCnt} ) AGG ORDER BY FAULT_CNT DESC, FAULT_RATE DESC, TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
